justification: Adds a pre-extraction layout preflight to dcp_extract_changed.py: per-chapter measurement of two-column body pages (word x-span banding), rotated-char pages, garbled pages, and empty text layers, BEFORE any parse. Feeds suspect_reason so structural hazards are named up front instead of surfacing only as post-extraction schema_fail artifacts. Origin: the Ashfield PC|DS two-column interleave and KG scanned/garbled layers were both caught only after extraction on 2026-07-29.
addendum_columnar_reader: Same branch also adds the geometric two-column READER (_find_gutter/_columnar_text, GEOMETRIC_COLUMN_COUNCILS) that ACTS on what the preflight detects: finds the gutter from word x-geometry (no per-council boundary_x, unlike the header-pair COUNCIL_COLUMN_CONFIGS path), reads left-column-then-right per horizontal band, keeps full-width headings in place. Runs only for ashfield/marrickville/city_of_sydney, only after the upright filter, and returns None (plain fallback) on any non-two-column page. End-to-end proof: Ashfield ch.D review-mode extraction — the preflight_two_column SUSPECT flag CLEARED and provisions recovered rose 546->638; remaining count_drop is vs an inflated baseline (earlier duplicated part-copies), a human-review judgement, not interleave. 8 columnar unit tests incl. single-column-returns-None and full-width-heading-kept-in-place; a caught bug (same-y left+right merged as full-width) fixed via gutter-gap test. Extractor suites 255 green.

pre_impl.existing_data: Post-extraction gates exist (schema_fail, count_drop, coverage_fail, truncation_fail) and stayed untouched; no pre-extraction layout detector existed (prior-art guard hits were SEPP markdown parsers, unrelated). Validated on real PDFs: Ashfield chapter D flags (78/192 two-column pages - the known interleave source); Waverley measures 404/450 but is exempted by evidence (2026-07-28 full fidelity sweep proved its margin-note layout handling).
pre_impl.assumption_mismatch: A margin-note layout council could false-flag as two-column; the flag is advisory (suspect line, never blocks extraction) and the PREFLIGHT_TWO_COL_VERIFIED allowlist requires sweep-level evidence to suppress it.
pre_impl.new_vs_existing: Pure additive: one pure detector + one measuring function + a report print + a suspect_reason branch ordered AFTER all existing reasons; preflight failure returns {} and changes nothing.

functions.name: detect_two_column_words
functions.input: list of (x0,x1) word spans plus page width
functions.output: True when both lateral bands hold >=25% of words and <5% cross the gutter band
functions.if_none: fewer than 30 words or zero page width returns False (sparse pages never flag)

functions.name: preflight_layout
functions.input: pdf path + council slug; opens the PDF with pdfplumber
functions.output: counts of two-column/rotated/garbled/empty pages plus two advisory fail booleans
functions.if_none: any exception returns {} and extraction proceeds exactly as before - preflight can never block

values.if_missing: not applicable - module constants; thresholds documented inline with their evidence requirement

break_it.scenario: Waverley re-extraction gets smeared as suspect because its margin layout reads as two-column.
break_it.what_happens: Without the allowlist every Waverley review would carry a false suspect line against a sweep-proven extraction.
break_it.how: PREFLIGHT_TWO_COL_VERIFIED exemption, gated on full-sweep evidence; verified live (two_column_fail False for the Waverley PDF).

break_it.scenario: A corrupt PDF makes pdfplumber raise inside the preflight.
break_it.what_happens: Preflight prints a skip line and returns {}; extraction and all existing gates behave exactly as before.
break_it.how: Whole function wrapped; suspect_reason treats missing preflight as clean.
break_it.repro: point preflight_layout at a non-PDF file

break_it.scenario: Preflight adds a full pdfplumber pass per chapter and slows the cron.
break_it.what_happens: Seconds per chapter on the same file the extractor opens anyway.
break_it.how: Single pass, no OCR/network; acceptable against multi-minute extractions.

post_merge.manual_verify: Yes - next --review run prints the Preflight line per chapter and flags two-column/scanned chapters in the SUSPECT summary.
